Submit a tool.

Help others find useful tools for documents, data, and semantics.

Submit by email

Send your submission to document.ai.tool@gmail.com. We review submissions against our editorial policy before listing them.

Open submission email ↗

Opens a draft in your email app. Review it and send when ready.

What to include

  • Name, URL, and a one-sentence tagline. Explain the specific job your tool does.
  • Which category it belongs to. Choose a primary category from our nine task categories; add related categories if useful.
  • Which workflow stage it helps with. Select one or more stages below and explain the input and expected result.
  • Pricing and availability. State whether it is Free, Free trial, Freemium, Subscription, Usage-based, or Enterprise quote. Mark Open source separately, specify the license, and note hosting, compute, or external model costs.
  • A GitHub link if open-source. Include relevant code and model licenses.
  • Official documentation, a demo, and important limitations. Link to a working demo or reproducible example; note format limits, output structure, provenance, and deployment requirements.
  • A product contact and a link to current pricing. For free projects, link to the license or page confirming availability instead.

Workflow stages

A stage describes where the tool helps in a workflow. Stages can overlap and do not need to be used in sequence.

Document intake, classification & splittingParsing & OCRLayout & table reconstructionSchema-based field extractionFormat conversion & database constructionOntology & semantic modelingMultimodal retrieval & RAGVisual document understandingAgentic orchestration, verification & repair

Suggestions and corrections

Have a suggestion, a correction, or another idea? Contact document.ai.tool@gmail.com. Include the relevant page and supporting links when possible.

Submission does not guarantee inclusion or featured placement. Editorial placement is not for sale.
